summary: n8n_execute sends n8n-packages.import-package as multipart/form-data: params.package is file content resolved the same way as typed MCP uploads (base64 by default, optional package_filename), and other params become form fields.
reason: POST /n8n-packages/import requires multipart/form-data with a binary package part; the code-orchestration route only sent JSON bodies and the per-endpoint upload handlers are not registered. A regen must keep that multipart route and the generator's MCP upload input (base64 content unless N8N_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT is set).
validated_outcome: TestCodeOrchUploadsPackageAsMultipart: base64 package content is uploaded as the multipart file part with projectId; a plain filesystem path is rejected; a missing params.package is a tool error.
